profile.summary: ViroHyena is a small family of nucleotide language models built on the Hyena architecture by the authors of the ViroBench viral genomics benchmark. They were pretrained on ViroBlend, a 216 Mbp corpus that mixes human reference, multi-species and viral sequences. The models take nucleotide sequences and serve as baselines in ViroBench for viral taxonomy and host classification from embeddings and for likelihood-based genome modelling.
profile.summary_source_locator: Model card introduction; ViroBench README: benchmark description and evaluation protocol

summary_quotes.text: **ViroHyena** is a Hyena-based nucleotide language model pre-trained on the **ViroBlend** corpus, a 216 Mbp mixed pretraining dataset with source-wise stratified sampling to balance human reference, multi-species genomes, and viral in-domain sequences.
The model was introduced as a baseline in the paper [ViroBench: Benchmarking Nucleotide Foundation Models on Viral Genomics Tasks]
- Evaluate likelihood-based modeling using **BPB (bits-per-base)** as the primary metric

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: ViroHyena uses the HyenaDNA model type: stacked Hyena layers over a nucleotide vocabulary of 12 tokens and a maximum of 8192 positions. The four checkpoints differ in width and depth, from d_model 128 with 2 layers to d_model 1024 with 20 layers. The cards tag the models for text generation. In ViroBench, classification is done with the backbone frozen: a sequence embedding is extracted and a small MLP head is trained on it. Generation diagnostics score likelihood in bits per base and test completion of coding sequences.

quotes.text: We adopt a unified evaluation protocol where the **backbone is frozen** and only a **lightweight head** is trained

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: Four checkpoints are on Hugging Face under YDXX: ViroHyena-436k, -1m, -6m and -253m. The model card table lists ViroHyena-436K (0.436M parameters), 1.6M, 6.6M and 253M. The 6m card says it is the 6.6M parameter version; the 1m configuration (d_model 256, 2 layers) matches the 1.6M row. A result should name the Hugging Face repository and revision; this page read 436k at 53c3fa04, 1m at 05cfe571, 6m at 9498a2ca and 253m at c9ef926a. The ViroBench README asks users to record checkpoint versions, environment and hardware.

facts.label: Model type
facts.value: Nucleotide language model (HyenaDNA type), tagged for text generation, released as a baseline for the ViroBench benchmark.
facts.source_locator: Model card introduction; config.json; API cardData

quotes.text: **ViroHyena** is a Hyena-based nucleotide language model

facts.label: Architecture
facts.value: Hyena layers (HyenaDNA configuration). 436k: d_model 128, 2 layers. 1m: d_model 256, 2 layers. 6m: d_model 256, 8 layers. 253m: d_model 1024, 20 layers.

facts.label: Inputs
facts.value: Nucleotide sequences, tokenised with a vocabulary of 12 tokens. The sources read do not describe the tokens.

facts.label: Outputs
facts.value: Sequence likelihoods and generated continuations (the generation tasks), and sequence embeddings used with a trained MLP head for classification. These are the uses ViroBench makes of its baselines.

strengths.text: A size ladder from 0.436M to 253M parameters on the same pretraining corpus, which suits scaling comparisons.

The pretraining mix deliberately includes viral sequences alongside human and multi-species genomes. The ViroBench authors report that taxonomic diversity in pretraining data mattered more than parameter scale in their ablations.

quotes.text: to balance human reference, multi-species genomes, and viral in-domain sequences
controlled ablation studies reveal that taxonomic diversity in pretraining data outweighs parameter scale

strengths.text: Weights are Apache-2.0 licensed and not gated.
strengths.source_locator: Hugging Face API cardData and gated

limitations.text: No usage instructions are published for the checkpoints. The model cards have no loading code, and the ViroBench README runs other models and expects model-specific setup from each model's own documentation.
limitations.source_locator: Model card; ViroBench README: Installation, Quickstart

quotes.text: For model-specific setup (e.g. Evo2, HyenaDNA), please refer to each model’s official documentation.

limitations.text: The context is limited to 8192 positions, and the pretraining corpus is small at 216 Mbp.
The developers attach a biosecurity notice: the model must not be used to design or operationalise harmful biological agents, and they suggest controlled access for released outputs.

no_run_guide_reason: The model cards contain no loading or inference code. The ViroBench README's examples run another model (evo2_1b_base) and refer users to each model's official documentation for model-specific setup. A run guide would have to invent commands.
notes: The record description says ViroHyena was pretrained on viral sequences; the model cards say ViroBlend mixes human reference, multi-species and viral sequences. The Hugging Face repository suffixes (1m, 6m) differ from the card's names (1.6M, 6.6M).
